title: YAOM
description: A collection of community-made mods designed to dramatically improve a game's performance, frame rate (FPS), and load times.
body:
**Important:** Use this tool to convert modpack into .zip https://fabulously-optimized.github.io/mrpack-to-zip/
## ⚡ Performance Unlocked
YAOM is faster than competing game clients, thanks to modern performance engines like Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore. Every bundled mod is carefully selected and rigorously tested to be safe in your worlds while providing massive, noticeable speed benefits on any device—from low-end laptops to high-end gaming rigs.
## 🎨 Complete OptiFine Parity
Never worry about compatibility again. YAOM supports almost all OptiFine features out of the box, including custom shaders, connected textures, dynamic lights, and cinematic zoom.
## 🏆 The "Must-Have" Feature Set
While other packs stop at performance, YAOM delivers the essential tools every player actually needs. Experience Minecraft exactly how you want to with built-in game controller support, easy local world hosting to play with friends instantly, widescreen advancement menus, and highly requested quality-of-life tweaks that make standard vanilla feel obsolete.
## 🌍 Works Everywhere
Because YAOM strictly avoids heavy content mods, it alters no base mechanics. You can safely join any standard multiplayer server or existing single-player world. We support all major modern launchers, ensuring an effortless setup and a bug-free multiplayer experience.
## ⏰ Always Up to Date
Never get left behind on older versions. YAOM receives lightning-fast updates, standing as one of the very first modpacks to upgrade whenever a new game version drops.
🛠️ Built on Fabric
Powered by the ultra-lightweight Fabric mod loader, YAOM runs with minimal system overhead. This modular design makes it the perfect, rock-solid foundation for your own custom setup—feel free to drop in your favorite extra mods without breaking the core engine.
